description: 3-step minimal script for the control-flip demo: get_order, issue_refund (the only violation), then a final answer that never claims the refund was issued. This is deliberate — the fixture agent cannot react to a blocked tool call, so the demo only works if nothing downstream of issue_refund makes a claim that would be false when the guardrail blocks it. See fixtures/tasks/refund_policy_control_demo.json.
